constants_sources.prune_k: C1b's K 5 and 15 of 4,608 units scaled to 12,288 (0.11%, 0.33%)
constants_sources.reverse_lr: a tenth of E54's forward 3e-5: Jain et al. reverse below the forward rate; C1 used lr/10
constants_sources.cap_steps: about 10x the expected half-life at lr/10; censoring instead of a cap value (review S6)
constants_sources.noise_floor: R: measured random-removal spread in shares of D (job 1); t_half: one optimizer step
constants_sources.gap_mult: E51's separation rule and C1b's 3 sd convention
constants_sources.bands: thirds of the axis, this project's; edge decided by the bootstrap, not one seed
constants_sources.distance_tol: unsourced: this project's choice, like the bands (review m2)
constants_sources.prior_tol: unsourced: this project's choice, like the bands (review m2)

definitions.kappa(m): mean over score-half windows of KL(p_W0 || p_m) at the answer position, nats
definitions.D: kappa(state); void if D < D_void_frac x the smallest pole-map mean D (job 1)
definitions.Delta_K: (kappa(state) - kappa(top-K pruned)) - mean over n_random random K-unit removals of (kappa(state) - kappa(random pruned)); units = 4 x 3072 MLP neurons zeroed at site mlp<l> at every position; top-K by Alg. 3's grad . w on up_proj row (+bias if any) of the fit-half mean kappa at the state
definitions.R: max over K of Delta_K / D (max over K biases R up equally for every state)
definitions.t_half: first step at which kappa falls to D/2, linearly interpolated between the straddling steps; 'censored' if not by cap_steps
definitions.q: per map, max over lens blocks of mean over the map's trained-key held-out windows of [log P_lens(own value) - mean over the map's other distinct values of log P_lens(value)]; W0 only
definitions.p: (mean_elicit - mean_cipher) / (mean_rank1 - mean_cipher), seed means over non-void seeds
definitions.prior: per map, mean over score-half windows of log p_W0(value) at the answer position; W0 only; baseline column
definitions.p_prior: p computed on the prior column

rules.gap: noise = max within-map seed sd over rank1, cipher, elicit, floored per noise_floor; gap = mean_rank1 - mean_cipher; 'ok' iff d * gap >= gap_mult * noise (d = +1 for R and q, -1 for t_half); 'reversed' iff -d * gap >= gap_mult * noise; else 'no gap'. Undirected baseline columns (update size, D, mlp_share) use |gap|.
rules.censoring: any censored pole seed -> t_half 'censored' (void); censored elicit or copy seeds are reported and dropped
rules.side: only with gap 'ok': 'VPD' iff p >= vpd_min; 'label' iff p <= label_max; else 'between'; ties to the outer band; p > 1 -> 'VPD', p < 0 -> 'label'
rules.firm: bootstrap: resample seeds with replacement within each map, draws x; a zero-denominator draw is outside every band; the side holds only if the 5th and 95th percentiles of p lie in its band, else 'between'
rules.distance: if p_D has gap 'ok': an instrument whose firm side equals p_D's side, or whose p is within distance_tol of p_D, reads 'distance'
rules.void: a map with fewer than 2 non-void seeds -> the column is 'void'
rules.verdict_per_instrument: one of VPD, label, between, distance, prior, distance and prior, no gap, reversed, censored, void
rules.verdict_joint: 'shared' iff both VPD; 'shared (by X)' iff X reads VPD and the other no gap, void or censored; 'VPD alone' / 'VPD alone (by X)' likewise with label; 'conflict' iff one VPD and the other label or reversed; else 'not settled', naming each
rules.prior: if p_prior has gap ok: an instrument whose firm side equals p_prior's, or whose p is within prior_tol of p_prior, reads 'prior'; both distance and prior -> 'distance and prior'; r and stand-in ratio put through rules distance and prior too, reported

edge_cases_run.empty_pool: a map with < 2 non-void seeds -> column void
edge_cases_run.zero_denominator: gap 0 -> 'no gap'; zero-denominator bootstrap draws count as outside (matters where rank1 and cipher nearly tie, e.g. S)
edge_cases_run.censoring: rule 'censoring'; no cap value enters a mean
edge_cases_run.D_floor: relative floor; unnormalised Delta reported beside R
edge_cases_run.distance_without_gap: p_D 'no gap' -> the distance rule does not fire
edge_cases_run.prior_without_gap: p_prior no gap -> rule prior does not fire
edge_cases_run.prior_in_vpd_band: a firm VPD-band p_prior turns every VPD reading (r included) into prior: intended, outcome (f); expected p_prior about (-6.4+13.7)/(-2.5+13.7) = 0.65, between, so only the 0.1 clause can fire; r 0.876 would not
edge_cases_run.planted_unreachable: bisection fallback; pass rules relative to the planted state's own D and ceiling

implementation_details.sd: within-map seed sd is the sample sd (n - 1), which reproduces the plan worked examples (r: 3 sd 0.050)
implementation_details.gap_zero: a gap of exactly 0 is no gap for every column, directed or not (so a zero-noise column with gap 0 is not ok)
implementation_details.prior_direction: the prior column is undirected (|gap|), the same treatment as D (rule 6: as distance)
implementation_details.percentiles: the 5th and 95th percentiles are taken without interpolation (numpy method lower for the 5th, higher for the 95th); a zero-denominator draw is placed at -inf for the 5th and +inf for the 95th, so it counts against every band
implementation_details.firm: a point side VPD holds iff the 5th percentile >= vpd_min; label iff the 95th <= label_max; a point between stays between
implementation_details.rules_5_6_scope: rules 5 and 6 fire only when both the instrument column and the baseline column read gap ok; tolerance inclusive (|p - p_base| <= tol)
implementation_details.planted_block: planted.block 3 = steering.Net site mlp3, the last of the four blocks (0-based, as the sites are named)
implementation_details.planted_units: candidates must also have mean activation > 0 (the edit divides by it); single-unit zeroing cost measured on the fit half (the half that scores units), ties to the lower unit id
implementation_details.planted_alpha: doubling from alpha 1 then 40 bisection steps, assuming kappa and the off-answer KL rise with alpha
implementation_details.probe_values: q: the map other distinct values are all 32 keys values (trained and held-out keys, each value once, heldout_keys.pool_of), on the 75 trained-key held-out windows
implementation_details.reverse_loss_precision: the reverse fine-tune loss runs under finetune.logits_of (bf16 autocast, as the forward E54 recipe); kappa is read in fp32 with float64 sums
implementation_details.reverse_reference: finetune.finetune_to_reference takes a frozen W0 copy of the target model as the reference module (the plan named ref_logprobs; W0 log-probs at every position of every train window would not fit in memory)

amendment_1.why: Job 1 (cluster job 46774) built the planted wrapper as filed and it could not work: block 3's median answer-position activation is negative, so the 13 lowest-cost above-median units were nearly silent (abar 0.002-0.097); the edit -alpha * w / abar_j scaled them up to ~400x at every position, and the off-answer KL bound (0.577) stopped it at kappa 0.184 against a target of 7.0, below D_void (0.978). Its pruning check (4 of 13, R 0.39) is noise, not a pruning failure. reports/reviews/2026-10-31_review_e55-c3-code.md findings 1-2; plan section 'Amendment 1, 2026-10-31: planted control'. Filing A's text is unchanged; the keys under amendment_1.planted replace constants.planted's keys of the same name and add the floor.

planted.units: on W0 and the fit half, per block-3 unit j: a_ans = mean GELU activation at the answer position, a_else = mean |activation| over every other position; candidates have a_ans above the block's active_quantile quantile of a_ans and above 0; the 13 planted units are the candidates with the largest a_ans / a_else (ties to the lower id). Single-unit zeroing costs are no longer measured.
planted.edit: down_proj columns += -alpha * w (the same alpha for every unit; no 1/abar), w = unit vector of the fit-half mean of (u_rank1(key) - u_mean)
planted.D_floor: floor = max(D_void, D_floor_frac x target_D), D_void = D_void_frac x the smallest pole-map mean D, target_D = the median D of the six pole states. Planted D >= floor: the control is built and the pass rules apply. Planted D < floor: the control is void ('control not built'), not failed: the planted pruning pass is not scored and reads 'void'; the pruning instrument then has no positive control and is void as after a miss, reported as 'control not built'. The planted reverse check is unchanged and runs at any D.
planted.D_floor_frac_source: this project's choice: keeps the planted D within the range of the real pole states (D 4.4-10.6 in job 1)
planted.pass_unchanged: found_in_top13_min 10, R_min 0.8 x ceiling, reverse rule: all as filed in constants.planted.pass
